fullText:
How has neuroscience changed in the past 10 years? I reread The Future of the Brain, a 2014 compilation of essays from neuroscientists, to see if we accomplished what we said we would. Atlases! Connectomes! Whole brain simulations!

Not everything panned out, but we did pretty well. Why we succeeded is interesting: from goal and agenda setting, to defining new capabilities, to thinking deeply about institutions. There are some interesting metascience lessons to be learned.
